# AXL

> > AXL is an all-in-one e-learning and online school platform combining marketing automation, sales funnels, and webinar hosting for course creators and educators worldwide.

AXL (AXL EdTech Booster LLC) provides a comprehensive ecosystem for building and scaling online education businesses. The platform is available in multiple languages including English, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese, and Indonesian, serving a global audience of educators, course creators, and online school operators.

## Key Topics

- All-in-one e-learning platform
- Marketing automation
- Sales funnels
- Online school platform
- Lead generation and segmentation
- Webinar hosting
- Email marketing
- Omnichannel messaging
- Pay-as-you-go pricing
- Free trial
- Case studies
- Partnership program
- Customer segmentation
- Affiliate program
- WhatsApp integration

- [AXL Platform (English)](https://axl.tech/): AXL all-in-one ecosystem for online schools with marketing, sales, and training tools
- [AXL Platform (Spanish)](https://axl.tech/es): AXL e-learning platform with marketing, sales, and training tools for Spanish-speaking educators
- [AXL Platform (Russian)](https://axl.tech/ru): AXL all-in-one online school platform with marketing and webinar tools for Russian market
- [AXL Platform (Ukrainian)](https://axl.tech/ua): AXL platform for online schools with marketing and education tools for Ukrainian users
- [AXL Platform (Indonesian)](https://axl.tech/id): AXL ecosystem for online schools with marketing automation for Indonesian educators
- [AXL Platform (Portuguese)](https://axl.tech/pt): AXL all-in-one e-learning platform for course creators and online school operators
